evidence: Touches src/net_processing.cpp and orphan handling, with the P2P area label.
rationale: Prevents peers from blocking message processing and holding cs_main during orphan transaction reconsideration. When orphans repeatedly fail due to missing inputs, evaluating all of them in a single turn stalls other peers; interrupting after every validation limits starvation and strengthens DoS resilience following CVE-2024-52914 mitigations.
